sec.title: Correction to: Cardiovasc Diabetol (2021) 20:100 10.1186/s12933-021-01293-8
sec.p: Following publication of the original article [1], the authors noticed an error in the second author’s name.
The name of the second author, "Gregory Y. H. Lip", was incorrectly written as "Gregory-Y H Lip". This has been corrected with this erratum.
The original article [1] has been corrected.
